text:
Alyssa Lin (AE): Heads-up team — CedarPoint RFI due Friday EOD. They want a capability matrix, POC schedule, on-prem HSM details, pricing tiers, SLA bullets, and sample prompt suite. I'm assembling responses now and uploaded an initial matrix draft: /files/cedarpoint_rfi_matrix_v0.1.csv

Mike Chen (SE): Got it. I'll add model compatibility rows (Redwood-verified models), quantization support, max-seq per variant. Quick Q: do we need to call out prefix/KV cache behavior for their latency-sensitive use case?

Samir Patel (Security): Security Qs to flag: KMS vs HSM semantics. Short answer: Hosted supports customer-managed keys via cloud KMS; Private supports KMS or integration with customer HSMs (CloudHSM or on-prem integrations). We do NOT ship physical HSM appliances. Need to include key rotation policy, audit log retention periods, and how we handle tenant isolation for Private. I'll draft language.

Rachel Gomez (Solutions): I'll own the POC timeline and attachments. Proposed POC: week 0-1 bench + integration, week 2 model tune & eval, week 3 performance tuning + canary, week 4 handover. Need Dedicated capacity numbers for an 8xA100-equivalent baseline to estimate costs. @Mike can you paste perf numbers so I can justify duration?

Mike Chen (SE): Perf snippet for matrix (draft):
```
Model | Quantization | MaxSeq | Typical throughput (tokens/s)
Llama2-70B (q4f) | int8/q4f | 8k | 120 (single-request), ~300 (batched)
Redwood-3-13B | q5_0 | 4k | 420
```
I'll attach bench CSV: /files/cedarpoint_bench_8xA100.csv

Alyssa Lin (AE): Buyer asked about pricing: "Is there a fixed per-token price for hosted vs dedicated?" Proposed draft numbers (do not send externally yet): hosted gen $0.015 / 1k tokens, embeddings $0.02 / 1k; Dedicated: committed monthly starting $25k/mo for 8x baseline with overage at $0.008 / 1k tokens. Mark as draft – finance/legal to sign off.

OpsBot: Reminder: Please redact any PII and remove API keys before uploading attachments.

Samir Patel (Security): They also asked about compliance: SOC2 and FedRAMP. Short: Hosted service is SOC2 Type II; Private deployments can be run in FedRAMP-authorized customer environments but Redwood itself is not FedRAMP-authorized. Will include checkbox responses for SOC2, ISO27001 (in progress), and incident response SLA.

Rachel Gomez (Solutions): Can we attach evaluation artifacts? They want a sample prompt suite and example eval results. I'll attach: /attachments/cedarpoint_prompts_v1.zip and /attachments/cedarpoint_eval_results_v1.pdf

Alyssa Lin (AE): Action items: Mike — add perf rows & attach bench CSV. Samir — draft security Q answers (KMS/HSM wording, key rotation, audit retention, FedRAMP note). Rachel — finalize POC timeline and attach prompt/eval artifacts. I'll compile everything and send to buyer by EOD Thursday. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Mike Chen (SE): On it — will ping if I need clarifications on model variants.

Samir Patel (Security): Drafted security answers and pushed to /files/cedarpoint_security_answers_v0.2.docx — please review before we send.

Alyssa Lin (AE): Perfect. I'll do a final pass for commercial language and place everything in the RFI package.
